pullRequests.title: Alpha 5: desktop acceptance and runtime hardening
pullRequests.head: alpha5-desktop-hardening
pullRequests.body: Starts Alpha 5 with a real acceptance harness rather than claiming GUI behavior from unit tests. Adds a Linux/macOS/Windows CI matrix, cross-platform syntax validation, privacy-safe runtime diagnostics, explicit shortcut registration status, and a rewritten desktop acceptance checklist. The runtime is bumped to 1.0.0-alpha.5. Real GUI smoke tests on physical/current macOS and Windows remain a manual acceptance requirement.

pullRequests.title: Alpha 5.1: build unsigned macOS and Windows test artifacts
pullRequests.head: alpha5-packaging
pullRequests.body: Adds a Test Builds workflow that validates source and packages unsigned macOS DMG/ZIP (x64 + arm64) and Windows NSIS/portable x64 artifacts. Artifacts are retained for 14 days and are explicitly documented as acceptance builds, not signed public releases.
